sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate preserves the required IA and IA Super pre-2003 applicability branches, adds post-2003 non-applicable alternatives, targets all supplied properties on ship, uses the canonical namespace and datatypes, and correctly selects only assessment dates later than 1 January of the delivery-year-plus-twenty deadline as violations.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Add a non-applicable alternative for iceClass IA with constructionStageDate >= "2003-09-01"^^xsd:date. As written, IA ships constructed on or after 1 September 2003 match none of the sh:or branches and are incorrectly reported as violations, although the requirement applies only to IA Super or IA ships whose construction stage was before that date.

Preserve the prior IA non-applicable alternative, but extend applicability to IA Super: the requirement applies only when the construction-stage date is before 2003-09-01 for either iceClassIaSuper or iceClassIa. Require the ApplicableShape deadline check only for those pre-2003-09-01 cases, and add or revise the non-applicable alternative so IA Super with constructionStageDate >= 2003-09-01 passes without requiring deliveryDate or assessmentDate. As written, a post-2003 IA Super ship incorrectly enters ApplicableShape and is subjected to the deadline.

Reject: the DeadlineCheck SPARQL constraint has inverted pass/fail logic. Its FILTER selects assessment dates on or before the computed deadline, so compliant cases are reported as violations while late assessments can pass. Change the constraint to select only assessmentDate values later than 1 January of delivery year + 20, e.g. YEAR(?assessmentDate) > ?deadlineYear || (YEAR(?assessmentDate) = ?deadlineYear && (MONTH(?assessmentDate) > 1 || (MONTH(?assessmentDate) = 1 && DAY(?assessmentDate) > 1))). Preserve the existing IA and IA Super pre-2003 applicability and post-2003 non-applicable alternatives.

The candidate preserves the required IA and IA Super pre-2003 applicability branches, adds post-2003 non-applicable alternatives, targets all supplied properties on ship, uses the canonical namespace and datatypes, and correctly selects only assessment dates later than 1 January of the delivery-year-plus-twenty deadline as violations.
